evidence_status: Software and artifact contract only; no large public artifact has been audited.

sharding.required_coverage: exactly [0, n*(n-1)/2) with no gap or overlap

independent_verification.proof_obligation: Every pair at positive Jaccard similarity shares at least one 5-gram; exact enumeration of all shared-gram pairs is therefore recall-complete for every frozen positive threshold.
independent_verification.reported_score_rule: exact Jaccard rounded to 12 decimal places

required_before_freezing: Independent review that the engine enumerates every pair ordinal in each assigned range
Conformance tests against exhaustive character-5-gram Jaccard on adversarial small fixtures
Failure injection for missing, duplicated, overlapping, truncated, and early-terminated shards
A site-local resource plan that does not place private text or matched spans in the audit bundle

limitations: This contract validates immutable inputs, exact pair-space coverage, shard hashes, and reported findings, then independently enumerates all positive-similarity candidates with a disk-backed complete shared-5-gram join; it does not make lexical similarity a semantic-independence test.
The engine implementation and runtime image must be independently reviewed and frozen before an external bundle can change an inconclusive large-artifact gate into a pass.
A passing external bundle cannot approve source, privacy, legal, leakage, or human-subjects reviews.
